message.content: {"cases":[{"target_alias":"SRC_001","attack":true,"case":"The problem requires RUNNING the experiment and reporting what actually happened; the target explicitly does not run anything ('Prediction, not measurement: I cannot execute code here') and instead asserts the outcome 'by construction'. It fabricates the two counts (4/4 fires, 3/4 held) as predictions rather than measured results, so the required side-by-side empirical record does not exist. Worse, it fails the second design constraint: the problem demands reporting the agreement pattern AND which commitments would have to exist for (a) and (b) to come apart — the target never discusses what would make them diverge, only noting the single G2/M3 disagreement it built in. It also invents no actual specification with real commitments, guards, or mutants; the 'suite' exists only as a one-line sketch, so nothing was falsified or could falsify the claim.","counterexample":[{"case":"A target that actually executed a small mutated-guard harness, printed observed kill/survive tables, and derived the fired-vs-held counts from that output would satisfy the run requirement; SRC_001 does the opposite.","eval":"observation"}],"premise":null,"premise_evidence":null}]}
message.reasoning: The target explicitly says it cannot run code: "Prediction, not measurement: I cannot execute code here." The problem demands RUNNING the experiment and reporting what actually happened. That's a genuine fault.
